dedupe_keys.name: osiris gcam agricultural climate input pipeline

description: osiris is an R package that prepares climate-driven agricultural productivity inputs for the Global Change Analysis Model. Its developers couple temperature and precipitation projections with crop-model emulators and socioeconomic assumptions to create GCAM change files. The JOSS paper places those files in analysis of future water, energy and land systems. Spatial coverage is the region or global climate dataset supplied; temporal coverage and resolution follow the chosen projection and GCAM scenario. The own R DESCRIPTION states BSD-2-Clause and the repository is public, so the software is free. A modeller can change climate pathways or yield assumptions and compare food-supply and irrigation consequences in GCAM. A caveat is that emulator structure, climate bias and assumed socioeconomic response can dominate results. osiris does not itself validate a crop-yield projection, and GCAM is a separate model with its own configuration. No matching catalogue or first-review software record was found. The article and own repository metadata were read without processing climate data.
